sourceEvidence.title: Director, Operations Excellence
sourceEvidence.quote: The Operations Excellence Director for Field Service will lead continuous improvement and operational governance across the company’s AM Region service organization. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Services, this role owns cross‑functional programs that improve Quality and Safety, optimize Spare Parts performance, strengthen Authorized Service Provider (ASP) networks, elevate Business Management discipline, and maximize Field Force Efficiency. The Director will translate strategy into measurable operational improvements that protect margin, increase customer satisfaction, and scale the service business as a profit center.
